summary: Stop CI running typecheck and the test suite twice per matrix job, and add CodeRabbit as an automated pull-request reviewer.

desktop.reason: No desktop runtime code changes. The build output is byte-identical: build:ci runs the same electron-vite build and build:server as build, and keeps the postbuild smoke test that build:fast alone would skip.

reactNativeIos.reason: apps/mobile is untouched. The mobile jest step still runs on ubuntu-latest only and mobile-ota.yml is unchanged.

nativeAndroid.reason: apps/android is untouched. android-native-ci.yml and mobile-release.yml keep their existing triggers, signing verification and APK checks.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No wire protocol, IPC channel, event shape or handler changes. src/shared is untouched.

storageDataMigration.reason: No schema, migration or persisted-state changes. src/main/db and src/main/conversations are untouched.

automated: npm run build:ci passes locally and the postbuild smoke test reports that the packaged main bundle boots cleanly, proving build:fast plus postbuild preserves the coverage that plain build gave.
The pre-commit hook ran the full repository gate: 3586 tests passed across 376 files, 3 skipped.
The four required checks on this pull request are the live proof, and they are the same four that branch protection on main now requires.
notExercised: The wall-clock saving is predicted from run 35192152144 step timings, where electron-vite started 81 seconds into the 93-second ubuntu Build step and roughly 95 seconds into the 108-second windows step. The post-change timing is not yet measured across several runs.
release.yml keeps its own duplicate gate deliberately and was not changed, so no tag has been cut through the new pull-request-then-tag release procedure in docs/releasing.md.

CodeRabbit reviewed pull request 78 and read .coderabbit.yaml with the CHILL profile, and its one finding was valid and fixed. The em dash path_instruction is still unverified, because no em dash appeared in this diff for it to catch.
